answer: Before the stamp comes 30 letters of reference, each one priced at £55, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. No Glovebound last maker saddle licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence last makers carry after last shop audits is why it holds. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. relic stays on the record. The yarrow is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps nectar.
